summary: The agent resolved the P0 objective and exact-demand slots, but never asked about the P1 contract-length diversity requirement or the P2 full-coverage and contract-count limits, and it failed to reach a final modeling state due to repeated low-value questions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
